name: Deepfish Detection
description: Deepfish Detection is an object detection dataset of underwater images annotated with bounding boxes for deepfish. It evaluates a model's ability to locate and count fish in natural underwater scenes given a detection prompt.
card_text: The dataset contains 200 samples pairing an underwater photograph with a short text instruction: 'Detect the deepfish in the given image'. The output is a dictionary keyed by 'deepfish' whose value is a list of bounding boxes, each specified as [x, y, width, height] coordinates. Images are real underwater scenes of varying complexity, containing from one to many fish. The task is open-set detection for a single fish class ('deepfish'). Annotations are provided as coordinates, not as textual descriptions. The dataset is intended for evaluating visual object detection models on marine imagery.

image.semantics: Underwater photograph of deepfish in their natural habitat; serves as the visual context for the detection task.

question.semantics: A short imperative prompt asking the model to detect deepfish in the provided image.

bbox.semantics: A list of bounding boxes around each detected deepfish, each box represented as [x, y, width, height] coordinates in the image.

meta.meta_structure_description: Each sample consists of an input image file and a text prompt instructing the model to detect deepfish, plus an output dictionary keyed by 'deepfish' containing a list of bounding boxes (x, y, width, height) for each detected fish in the image. There is no additional text context beyond the instruction.
